# `state/transaction/CommitCoordinator.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/transaction/CommitCoordinator.js`

state/transaction/CommitCoordinator.js — the atomic commit protocol (spec §7).  No authoritative state change happens outside this pipeline (spec rule 19). It runs the 14-step protocol over a sealed transaction envelope and a set of canonical registries, then either commits atomically and returns a signed witness receipt, or rejects with a receipt explaining what failed. The pipeline enforces the CSE safety invariants: single-spend USOs, expected versions, valid + non-revoked authority, fencing-token freshness, predicate and invariant checks, idempotent replay, and a post-state root that matches the committed outputs.
